Title: Polyinit
Description: All-in-one Polymarket toolkit: market browser, trading bots, leaderboards and referrals.
Type: Market Browser - Trading Bots - Leaderboards - Referrals
Full description: Polyinit is a third-party toolkit for Polymarket that combines a market browser with live prices and liquidity, automated trading bots, performance leaderboards, and a referral program, all in a single interface.
Cos'è: Polyinit is a third-party, all-in-one hub built around Polymarket, the prediction market platform on Polygon. Instead of one single feature, it bundles a market browser, trading bots, leaderboards and a referral program into one dashboard.
Come funziona:
• Browse Polymarket markets with live prices, volume and liquidity data.

  • Run automated trading bots on Polymarket markets.

  • Check leaderboards to identify and track top-performing traders.

  • Track your own trading performance with built-in analytics.

  • Earn through the referral program by inviting other traders.

Polyinit operates as a companion app to Polymarket via its Builder Program, rather than as an independent exchange.
quando usarlo:
Useful for Polymarket traders who want browsing, bots, leaderboards and analytics in one place instead of assembling separate tools.

Less suited for traders who need the deepest specialist tool in one specific area (e.g. a dedicated execution bot or a data-heavy analytics terminal), since Polyinit trades some depth for convenience.
Risks:
• Multi-tool hub: individual features may be shallower than dedicated specialist tools

  • Bot automation on fast or thin markets can compound losses quickly

  • Following leaderboards means inheriting other traders' drawdowns, not just their gains

  • Third-party tool: verify its custody model and any fees before committing significant funds

Full description: A cloud-hosted trading bot platform connecting to major CEXs via API, offering automated trading with technical indicator signals, a strategy and template marketplace, paper trading, and backtesting tools.
Cos'è:
Cryptohopper is a cloud-based platform that runs your trading bots 24/7 — even when your computer is off — by connecting to your exchange via API.

What makes it stand out is the marketplace: you can buy ready-made strategies, signals, and templates from other traders. It's like an app store for trading bots — some strategies are free, others cost a subscription. Quality varies wildly, so due diligence is non-negotiable.
Come funziona:
1. Sign up on cryptohopper.com and connect your exchange via API (trade-only permissions).

  2. Build a strategy using technical indicators, or buy one from the marketplace.

  3. Run a backtest on historical data to evaluate performance before going live.

  4. Activate the bot — it runs in the cloud and executes trades automatically on your exchange.

Paper trading mode lets you test strategies with fake money before risking real capital.
quando usarlo:
• When you want a bot that runs independently of your device being on.

  • When you want to test strategies via backtesting before deploying real funds.

  • When you want access to a marketplace of pre-built strategies.

  • When you trade across multiple exchanges and want centralized management.

Always backtest AND paper trade a strategy before going live — past performance does not guarantee future results.
Risks:
• Marketplace strategy risk: many sold strategies are overfitted to past data

  • API key exposure risk if platform is compromised

  • Subscription cost reduces profitability on small accounts

  • Cloud dependency: bot stops if platform has downtime

Title: Dextrabot
Description: Copy trading on-chain DEX with sniping, limit orders
Type: Sniper Bot - Limit Order Bot - Copy Trading - DEX Automation
Full description: A DEX trading automation tool offering token sniping, on-chain limit orders, copy trading, and anti-rug features across multiple chains including Ethereum, BSC, and Solana.
Cos'è:
Dextrabot is a bot built for DEX trading — the wild west of crypto where speed and automation are the difference between profit and getting left behind.

Its core feature is sniping: the bot monitors new token launches and buys in the same block they go live, faster than any human could. It's like having a robot finger on the trigger at a token launch, while everyone else is still reading the announcement.
Come funziona:
1. Connect your wallet to Dextrabot (non-custodial: you keep control of your keys).

  2. Choose your mode: Sniper (auto-buy on new token launch), Limit Order (buy/sell at target price), or Copy Trading (mirror on-chain wallets automatically).

  3. Set parameters: slippage tolerance, gas priority, anti-rug filters, max buy tax.

  4. The bot monitors the blockchain and executes transactions automatically when conditions are met.

Anti-rug filters can detect honeypot contracts and block purchases of flagged tokens before execution.
quando usarlo:
• When you want to participate in new token launches on DEX without being manually glued to the screen.

  • When you want on-chain limit orders that execute automatically at your target price.

  • When you want to copy the on-chain activity of known smart wallets or whale addresses.

  • When you're active in the meme coin space and need execution speed.

This is a high-speed, high-risk tool. Only use it if you understand DEX mechanics, gas fees, and token contract risks.
Risks:
• Sniping risk: buying into honeypots or rug pulls at launch despite filters

  • Gas war risk: in competitive launches, gas costs can exceed profits

  • Smart contract risk of the bot itself

  • Copy trading risk: the wallet you copy may intentionally front-run followers

  • High probability of total loss on sniped tokens that fail within minutes

Title: Bitget Bot
Description: Integrated futures bot with grid and martingale strategies
Type: Grid Bot - Martingale Bot Futures - Automated Trading
Full description: Bitget's native futures bot suite offering grid and martingale strategies for automated leveraged trading, integrated directly into the exchange with no external API required.
Cos'è:
Bitget's Futures Bot automates leveraged trading strategies — mainly grid and martingale — directly on the exchange without needing external tools.

The martingale strategy is the aggressive one: it doubles down on losing positions expecting a reversal. Like a gambler who keeps betting double after every loss — it works until it doesn't. Powerful if the market cooperates, catastrophic if it doesn't. Use with extreme caution and hard stop-losses.
Come funziona:
1. Futures Grid: Same grid logic as spot, but with leverage. Amplifies profits and losses within the range.

  2. Martingale Bot: Opens an initial position, then adds to it at set intervals if price moves against you, averaging down the entry price.

  3. Set leverage, position size, take profit, and stop-loss before activating.

  4. The bot runs 24/7 and closes positions automatically when targets are hit.

Always set a stop-loss on futures bots. Always.
quando usarlo:
• When you have solid experience with futures trading and understand leverage mechanics.

  • When you want to automate a short-term futures strategy without manual execution.

  • When you're using the martingale only with capital you can afford to lose entirely.

This is not a tool for beginners. Futures bots with leverage can liquidate your position faster than you can react.
Risks:
• Liquidation risk: leverage amplifies losses and can wipe the position entirely

  • Martingale risk: in a strong trend, doubling down compounds losses exponentially

  • Custodial risk: funds held on Bitget

  • Complexity risk: misconfigured leverage parameters can cause rapid capital loss

Title: Bybit Grid Bot
Description: Grid and DCA bots integrated natively on Bybit with simple UI
Full description: A suite of native trading bots on Bybit including grid bots for spot and futures and DCA bots for systematic accumulation, with a beginner-friendly interface and strategy marketplace.
Cos'è:
Bybit offers two main integrated bots: the Grid Bot and the DCA Bot — both designed to automate trading without requiring you to be in front of a screen.

The Grid Bot works like Binance's: buy low, sell high in a range, repeat. The DCA Bot is different — it buys a fixed amount at regular intervals regardless of price, averaging your entry cost over time. Like paying your rent in installments instead of all at once: you never know if you're catching the best price, but you avoid catching the worst.
Come funziona:
1. Grid Bot: Set price range and grid levels. Bot places layered buy/sell orders and profits from price oscillation within the range.

  2. DCA Bot: Set the asset, investment amount, and frequency (hourly, daily, weekly). Bot buys automatically at each interval regardless of price.

  3. Both bots run 24/7 without manual intervention once activated.

  4. Bybit also offers a strategy marketplace where you can copy proven bot configurations from other traders.
quando usarlo:
• Grid Bot: when the market is ranging and you want to profit from volatility.

  • DCA Bot: when you want to accumulate an asset over time without trying to time the market.

  • When you're new to bots and want a simple, guided setup experience.

  • When you want to copy a working strategy from the marketplace without building one from scratch.

DCA is one of the safest long-term strategies for beginners — Grid requires more market awareness.
Risks:
• Grid risk: losses if price breaks out of the defined range

  • DCA risk: averaging into a continuously declining asset

  • Custodial risk: funds held on Bybit

  • Copied strategies may not perform in different market conditions

Title: Binance Grid Bot
Description: Automated grid trading bot integrated natively on Binance
Full description: A native grid trading bot on Binance that automatically buys low and sells high within a defined price range, available for spot and futures markets with no external API required.
Cos'è:
The Binance Grid Bot is an automated tool that buys and sells crypto repeatedly within a price range you set — without you having to watch the screen.

Think of it like a market stall vendor who automatically buys apples at €1 and sells them at €1.10, over and over, as long as the price stays in that range. Every cycle generates a small profit. No price prediction needed — just a sideways or oscillating market.
Come funziona:
1. Set a price range (lower and upper limit) and the number of grid levels.

  2. The bot divides the range into equal intervals and places buy and sell orders at each level.

  3. Every time price drops to a buy level, the bot buys. Every time it rises to a sell level, the bot sells.

  4. The spread between each buy and sell is your profit per grid cycle.

Available on Spot and Futures. Futures grids allow leverage, which amplifies both gains and losses.
quando usarlo:
• When the market is moving sideways with no clear trend.

  • When you want to generate passive income without active trading.

  • When you already hold assets on Binance and want to put them to work.

  • When you're comfortable setting a price range and leaving the bot to run.

Avoid it in strong trending markets: a grid bot loses money when price breaks out of range and keeps going in one direction.
Risks:
• Trending market risk: losses when price exits the grid range sharply

  • Custodial risk: funds remain on Binance

  • Futures grid risk: leverage amplifies losses significantly

  • Opportunity cost: capital locked in grid may underperform simple holding in a bull run

  4. The bot executes trades automatically when signals are triggered.

OKX also has a strategy marketplace where you can browse and copy configurations from verified top traders.
quando usarlo:
• When you use TradingView and want to automate your technical analysis signals.

  • When you have a defined strategy and want to remove emotional execution from the equation.

  • When you want to run multiple automated strategies simultaneously across different pairs.

Not ideal for complete beginners: Signal Bots require understanding of indicators and strategy logic before deploying real capital.
Risks:
• Signal quality risk: bad signals lead to automated bad trades

  • Over-optimization: strategies that worked historically may fail in new market conditions

  • Custodial risk: funds held on OKX

  • Complexity risk: misconfigured bots can execute unintended trades
